items.title: Open Responses Joins AAIF with AWS Support
items.summary: The API format that a growing number of model providers use to call language models now has a vendor-neutral home. Open Responses has joined the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) as a project, bringing it under open governance alongside MCP and A2A. Based on the OpenAI Open Responses API, Open Responses is an open source specification […]
